reason: A linear map on the field may have a non-power-of-two image when restricted to the finite set of subgroup x coordinates. The first implementation incorrectly assumed the restricted image size was a power of two.
change: Keep the original F2^j label encoding and XOR combiner. Build the matched x-only SHA null by sorting distinct x/identity inputs by SHA256 and assigning the original used labels cyclically. This ensures exactly the same effective image size, while preserving x-only dependence and the ambient XOR alphabet. Report the per-bucket marginals, which need not be balanced on points because x has sign fibres.
unchanged: Exact single-bucket maximum, nominal and effective gains, full-group controls, direct-pair checks and rounding gate.
